what: A TB-303 style acid synth with its own pattern generator: press PLAY and a line plays. Generate, mutate and undo patterns up to 64 steps, edit steps in a piano roll, add drive, chorus, synced delay and plate reverb. The ATEK303 engine from VCV Rack with 14 oscillators and its fine tuning, 12 factory presets and 32 slots, MIDI in, out and clock.
author: Animatek
